description: Look up an existing Loc8ID by its short code, custom alias, or a pasted loc8id.com URL. Read-only — does not modify anything. Works for any public Loc8ID, not just the caller's own.

loc8id.description: A short code (e.g. "R7K3P"), a custom alias, or a full loc8id.com URL.

name: loc8id_get
